arguments.command:
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && cat > /tmp/merge-msg.txt <<'EOF'
chore(registry): merge latest master into automation/pi/tempmail-167

Resolve append conflicts in both READMEs and registry/sources.json by
keeping both new dashboards: `beszel` (already merged in #170) followed
by `tempmail` (this PR). Entry metadata, releases, and hashes are
preserved unchanged.
EOF
git commit -F /tmp/merge-msg.txt 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "=== log ==="; git log --oneline --graph -4
